# Sisko Dentistry

> Sisko Dentistry in Tallmadge, OH provides comprehensive restorative, cosmetic, and periodontal dental care with 225+ years of combined team experience.

Led by Dr. Gerald Sisko, this dental practice specializes in implants, Invisalign, crowns, bridges, and gum disease treatment. The practice serves Tallmadge and surrounding areas with a focus on patient education and cosmetic excellence.
